insights: erdos_moser_1965_bound was incorrectly stated as axiom: bound becomes 0 at N=1 (log(1)=0) making it false
The Erdős-Moser bound follows from the sharper Sárközy-Szemerédi bound for N ≥ 3 since (log N)^(3/2) ≥ 1
